messages:
mira: Quick heads-up — planning to cut release/2026.1 branch tomorrow 09:00 PT (2026-03-18 16:00 UTC). Cutoff for merges is ~36h from now. Need backport owners + changelog signoff. Storage/gateway/console owners?

sanjay: I can take storage backports. Will try to land tonight. @mira what's the base commit we should branch from?

alex: I'll take gateway. Can you post the list of high-priority PRs? Also, do we allow doc-only backports after cutoff?

mira: High-priority PRs to consider: #4682 (kv-evict fix), #4720 (gateway retry logic), #4745 (console telemetry opt-out). Docs: freeze at cutoff; doc-only fixes allowed after cutoff only with `doc-fix` label and maintainer approval.

jen: quick Q — version bump in package.json handled in CI or do we need a manual commit?

mira: We'll run an automated bump as part of the release job to avoid mismatches. Please avoid editing version numbers in PRs. Release job will tag.

ops-bot: Reminder: create branch from main at commit `abcdef1234567890`. Example commands:
```
git checkout -b release/2026.1 abcdef1234567890
git push origin release/2026.1
```

release-bot: CI status for main@abcdef1 — all checks passing except flaky tests: `tests/kv-evict-spec` failing intermittently.

sanjay: kv-evict-spec flaky on my backport runs. I can open a hotfix backport if reruns fail. Can someone rerun CI?

alex: I can rerun the pipeline for #4682 once you open the backport PR.

jen: I'll update the changelog draft at `docs/changelogs/2026.1.md` — ping me if you want different wording.

mira: Backport process for clarity: create PR targeting `release/2026.1`, include original PR link, add label `backport-2026.1`, get CI green, then ping me for merge. If CI flakes, add `flaky-backport` label and we'll triage.

sanjay: noted. One more — do we allow SQL storage schema changes (migrations) in this release?

mira: Migrations ok only if fully backward-compatible. Non-backwards-compatible migrations get delayed to next minor. If a migration is allowed, include migration script + rollback steps + a runbook note.

alex: I'll start the gateway backports tonight and tag owners on PRs.

jen: docs freeze reminder in ~6h :alarm_clock:

mira: Thanks all. Final pre-cut checklist I want to see before I announce the cut:
- branch created
- critical backports merged
- changelog updated
- release job passing
- release notes drafted
I'll post an update once the branch exists.

release-bot: created branch `release/2026.1` at `abcdef123` — https://git.example.com/repo/branches/release/2026.1

ops-bot: ci:rerun triggered for backport PR #4750 (requested by alex).

mira: Awesome — as you merge backports please add a short comment `backport approved` and include the original PR number so release notes can reference them. Thanks!
